instruction:
Read the National Gallery of Art's written record for Woman with a Parasol - Madame Monet and Her Son by Claude Monet. Report the creation year, medium, overall dimensions in centimetres, accession number and credit line. Keep overall dimensions separate from framed dimensions and the creation year separate from acquisition history. Cite the Artwork overview fields rather than interpreting the painting or opening an image download.

Stopping condition: Stop when the five requested collection fields are accurately labelled and cited to the National Gallery of Art record.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: Navigate to or access the record for 'Woman with a Parasol - Madame Monet and Her Son' on the National Gallery of Art website. Full credit if the agent successfully loads the page, or if the page is unavailable/down and the agent clearly reports this. Starting on the provided URL is acceptable.

Extract and report the creation year from the Artwork overview fields. Full credit if the creation year is accurately reported and kept explicitly separate from the acquisition history, OR if the information is unavailable on the page and the agent explicitly reports this. Partial credit if the year is reported but conflated with acquisition history.

Extract and report the medium of the artwork from the Artwork overview fields. Full credit if the medium is accurately reported based on the page content, OR if the information is unavailable on the page and the agent explicitly reports this.

items.criterion: Report the overall dimensions in centimetres
items.description: Extract and report the overall dimensions in centimetres from the Artwork overview fields. Full credit if the dimensions are in centimetres and kept explicitly separate from the framed dimensions, OR if the information is unavailable on the page and the agent explicitly reports this. Partial credit if the dimensions are provided but in the wrong units (e.g., inches) or conflated with framed dimensions.

Extract and report the accession number from the Artwork overview fields. Full credit if the accession number is accurately reported, OR if the information is unavailable on the page and the agent explicitly reports this.

Extract and report the credit line from the Artwork overview fields. Full credit if the credit line is accurately reported, OR if the information is unavailable on the page and the agent explicitly reports this.

items.criterion: Provide source URL, evidence, and adhere to constraints
items.description: Support the answers with observed page evidence and the source URL. Full credit if the agent cites the Artwork overview fields without interpreting the painting, without opening image downloads, and without using restricted methods (APIs, raw data, view-source).
